notes: Four-hour zero-extra-cost proof on standard ubuntu-latest only.
The runtime agent observes RPG Maker battle UI state and acts only through keyboard input; no game-state mutation, external LLM/API, paid runner, or GPU is allowed.
Game-over is a bounded learning event: preserve the defeat snapshot, raise the healing threshold, restart cleanly, and continue until the retry cap.
Emit compact strategy memory and an evidence-derived walkthrough alongside the trace; deaths remain explicit and are never reported as a no-death clear.
Promotion requires 14,400 seconds, continued route/game progression, no terminal fatal stop, and the LONG_RUN_4H_VERIFIED gate.
